name: How soon can I seal new grout after installation?
description: Wait until new grout is fully cured and dry before sealing. Most grout can be sealed after 48 to 72 hours, but some manufacturers call for longer.

mainEntity.name: How soon can I seal new grout after installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The safest move is to **wait until the grout is fully cured, clean, and completely dry** before sealing. For most cement-based grout, that means about 48 to 72 hours after installation, though some products need up to 7 days; after a deep clean, the grout should usually dry at least 24 hours before sealer goes on.
